 Jamie Foxx and Alyce Huckstepp have welcomed their first child together!
 The 58-year-old Oscar winner and the model, who is said to be in her early 30s, have been together on-and-off for years.
 The couple were first spotted out together in August 2023, though Alyce was on the red carpet at the premiere of Jamie ‘s movie Day Shift a whole year before that.
 News broke last year that they actually had broken up. 
 However, earlier this year, it was confirmed that they were expecting!
 1 
 This Is Jamie Foxx’s Third Child
 This is the first child for the couple, and third for Jamie. Jamie has two daughters: Corinne Foxx , born in 1994, and Anelise , born in 2008. Corinne ’s mother is Connie Kline , while Anelise ’s mother is Kristin Grannis . He brought both of his kids to the Grammys this year !
 A source confirmed to People that Alyce gave birth, though no additional details were revealed.
 Congrats to the happy couple on the wonderful news of the new addition!
 Stay tuned as we learn more. We have reached out to his rep for comment.
